arrays.name: clauses
arrays.semantic: Padded CNF clauses; positive=true, negative=false, zero=padding; OR within row and AND between rows.

rules: variable_array is a one-dimensional signed/unsigned integer array containing exact IDs 1..N in order.
clause_array is a two-dimensional integer array; each row is one OR clause and all rows are combined by AND.
Positive literal means true, negative literal means false, and zero is padding only — never a literal.
Every nonzero literal must reference an ID in 1..N.
logical_cnf.when_required: Required when requested_state.encoding is binary_assignment, or when the archive carries a CNF variable/clauses representation. Such an archive is rejected by generic numeric_archive_admissibility.

manifest.array_rule: Archive names must exactly equal manifest names; dtype and shape must exactly match. Only bool, signed/unsigned integer and floating arrays are accepted; object arrays are rejected.

request_body.poly_request: PartnerProf-PolyRequest/1.0 with source.kind=npz and source.sha3_512 over decoded bytes

semantics: Arrays are losslessly bound to the request-local certified archive field. Their values are not silently averaged, optimized or interpreted as scalar conclusions. The finite compute slice is declared in poly_request.
